description: Steps 7 and 8 of docs/the-delivery-loop.md: a reviewed branch validated on the real candidate, published, and reconciled with its pull request. The mandate is one JSON object naming the repo and the branch, with base and forge_repo optional. The latest review recorded by review-a-pinned-commit must be clean, and the flow refuses when the branch head, local or remote, differs from the reviewed commit. The combined tree is built on the current remote trunk in a locked worktree of its own, and scripts/run-gates.sh runs letter A plus every applicable letter of docs/gates.md there with --no-fail-fast; a red line stops the run, and lines that need a person are handed to one. The policy is read from the trusted trunk; `ask` on merge or push hands the push to a person. Just before the push the trunk is re-read, and a trunk that moved stops the run rather than validating something else; the publication gate runs on the candidate. It pushes only when green, then requires both that the remote trunk carries the candidate and that the host reports the pull request MERGED, not merely pushed. Every forge call runs as the account in sailor.forgeAs.

with.command:
set -eu
git -C "$REPO" fetch --quiet origin
trunk=$(git -C "$REPO" rev-parse --verify "refs/remotes/origin/$BASE^{commit}")
short=$(printf '%s' "$COMMIT" | cut -c1-12)
tree="$(dirname "$REPO")/$(basename "$REPO")-worktrees/integrate-$short"
if git -C "$REPO" merge-base --is-ancestor "$COMMIT" "$trunk"; then
    printf '{"tree":"","trunk":"%s","candidate":"%s","already":true}' "$trunk" "$trunk"
    exit 0
fi
if [ -e "$tree" ]; then
    git -C "$REPO" worktree unlock "$tree" 2>/dev/null || true
    git -C "$REPO" worktree remove --force "$tree" >&2
fi
mkdir -p "$(dirname "$tree")"
git -C "$REPO" worktree add --detach --lock --reason "integration of $COMMIT" "$tree" "$trunk" >&2
git -C "$tree" merge --no-ff --no-edit -m "Merge branch '$BRANCH'" "$COMMIT" >&2 || { git -C "$tree" merge --abort 2>/dev/null || true; echo "$BRANCH does not merge cleanly onto $BASE at $trunk" >&2; exit 1; }
candidate=$(git -C "$tree" rev-parse HEAD)
printf '{"tree":"%s","trunk":"%s","candidate":"%s","already":false}' "$tree" "$trunk" "$candidate"

set -eu
if [ "$ALREADY" = true ]; then
    printf '{"letters":"","ran":0,"red":0,"manual":0,"covered":0,"manual_pending":false,"green":true}'
    exit 0
fi
# The resolver and its manifest are the trunk's: a change may not choose the gates that judge it.
script=$(mktemp "${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/sailor-gates.XXXXXX")
manifest=$(mktemp "${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/sailor-manifest.XXXXXX")
covered=$(mktemp "${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/sailor-covered.XXXXXX")
trap 'rm -f "$script" "$manifest" "$covered"' EXIT
printf '%s' "$CHECKED" | python3 -c 'import json,sys; print("\n".join(str(item) for item in json.load(sys.stdin)))' > "$covered"
git -C "$REPO" show "$TRUNK:scripts/run-gates.sh" > "$script" || { echo "the trunk $TRUNK carries no scripts/run-gates.sh" >&2; exit 2; }
git -C "$REPO" show "$TRUNK:docs/gates.md" > "$manifest" || { echo "the trunk $TRUNK carries no docs/gates.md" >&2; exit 2; }
cd "$TREE"
sh "$script" --no-fail-fast --base "$TRUNK" --manifest "$manifest" --covered "$covered"

$join: The gates of docs/gates.md that apply to the combined tree

include lines a person must run or confirm (the step log of «gates» names them). Run them there and approve with an output file holding {"green": true} only when every one passed; reject with what was red.

options.label: green
options.facts: every manual line ran in the combined tree and passed

options.label: red
options.facts: a manual line failed; nothing is pushed

with.command:
set -eu
printf '%s' "$SAID" | python3 -c '
import json, sys
said = json.loads(sys.stdin.read())
if not isinstance(said, dict) or said.get("green") is not True:
    sys.exit("the person did not write green: true for the manual gates; nothing is pushed")
print(json.dumps({"confirmed": True}))
'

$join: The delivery policy read from the trusted trunk (commit
) asks a person before this flow may push the validated combined commit to the trunk. Approve with an output file holding {"authorized": true}, or reject with the reason.

options.label: authorize
options.facts: every check before this step passed on the recorded commit

options.label: refuse
options.facts: nothing outward has happened yet; the run stops here

with.command:
set -eu
printf '%s' "$SAID" | KEY="$KEY" python3 -c '
import json, os, sys
said = json.loads(sys.stdin.read())
if not isinstance(said, dict) or said.get(os.environ["KEY"]) is not True:
    sys.exit("the person did not write %s: true; nothing proceeds" % os.environ["KEY"])
print(json.dumps({"confirmed": True}))
'

set -eu
cd "$REPO"
# An inherited GH_REPO would point a call at another repository: it goes before the first gh call.
unset GH_REPO
forge_as=$(git -C "$REPO" config --get sailor.forgeAs) || { echo "sailor.forgeAs is not declared on this tree: refusing to act as the machine's active account" >&2; exit 1; }
[ -n "$forge_as" ] || { echo "sailor.forgeAs is empty on this tree: refusing to act as the machine's active account" >&2; exit 1; }
env -u GH_TOKEN -u GITHUB_TOKEN -u GH_REPO gh auth token --user "$forge_as" >/dev/null || { echo "no forge token for the declared account $forge_as" >&2; exit 1; }
[ -z "${FORGE_REPO:-}" ] || export GH_REPO="$FORGE_REPO"
# An empty --user or an empty GH_TOKEN makes gh answer as the machine's active account.
forge() {
    who=$(git -C "$REPO" config --get sailor.forgeAs) && [ -n "$who" ] || { echo "sailor.forgeAs vanished from this tree: refusing" >&2; exit 1; }
    token=$(env -u GH_TOKEN -u GITHUB_TOKEN -u GH_REPO gh auth token --user "$who") && [ -n "$token" ] || { echo "no forge token for $who: refusing" >&2; exit 1; }
    if [ -n "${FORGE_REPO:-}" ]; then
        env -u GITHUB_TOKEN -u GH_ENTERPRISE_TOKEN -u GITHUB_ENTERPRISE_TOKEN GH_REPO="$FORGE_REPO" GH_TOKEN="$token" gh "$@"
    else
        env -u GITHUB_TOKEN -u GH_ENTERPRISE_TOKEN -u GITHUB_ENTERPRISE_TOKEN -u GH_REPO GH_TOKEN="$token" gh "$@"
    fi
}
tries=0
while :; do
    state=$(forge pr view "$NUMBER" --json state --jq .state)
    [ "$state" = MERGED ] && break
    tries=$((tries + 1))
    [ "$tries" -lt 20 ] || { echo "the host still reports pull request $NUMBER as $state after the trunk carries it" >&2; exit 1; }
    sleep 3
done
printf '{"number":%s,"state":"%s"}' "$NUMBER" "$state"

set -eu
[ -n "$TREE" ] || exit 0
git -C "$REPO" worktree unlock "$TREE" 2>/dev/null || true
git -C "$REPO" worktree remove --force "$TREE"
